# `/machine-identity-user-entitlements` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /machine-identity-user-entitlements/v1

`listMachineIdentityUserEntitlementsV1` — List machine identity's user entitlements — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a list of user entitlements associated with machine identities.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: machineIdentityId: eq, in; machineIdentityName: eq, in, sw; entitlement.id: eq, in; entitlement.name: eq, in, sw; source.id: eq, in; source.name: eq, in, sw — e.g. `machineIdentityId eq "2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf44201"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: machineIdentityName, entitlement.name, source.name — e.g. `machineIdentityName`
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of machineidentityuserentitlementresponse
